other_failure_modes.name: Target Leakage in Target Encoding
other_failure_modes.description: Target encoding is applied to the training data by directly calculating the median target per category on the full training set and mapping it back, without using out-of-fold encoding or smoothing. This leaks the target variable into the training features, causing tree-based models to severely overfit to the training data.

summary: The agent provides a well-structured solution with appropriate handling of missing values and extensive feature engineering. However, a critical target leakage is introduced by performing naive target encoding directly on the training set without out-of-fold cross validation. Additionally, the data split is random despite the presence of temporal features, and the stochastic model is only evaluated once using a single metric.
